jobs.note: [rerun 2026-11-09 with ts3agent from master 85118e48 (reflect Describe IDictionary) + c9c472ce (dance-together-floor opens venues)] [est 40 min] BREAKS or CLEARS (~32 min). Release ini as is, dancefloorlistdiag on through the repro (phases A, B, then C repeated) on 4 floors at once. Cap 30 min: phases A+B take ~16 min (a cycle waits ~70 s for the slowest of 4 floors) = 48 single-pair floor routes (12 cycles x 4 floors, every second cycle with a forced collection), then phase C runs ~14 min with 6 NPCs dancing as 3 pairs on each of 4 floors = ~56 floor-minutes of a 6-NPC crowd, ~5x hit 1 (5-6 NPCs for ~10 min on one floor), so 0 throws here is clearly more floor use than the case that threw. Per-floor cam seen/far is logged on every cycle line (off-camera floors are evidence, not a problem). BREAKS: the early gate on fixes dancefloordiag_throws + _mismatch stops the job at the next guard poll; read in the job ts3native.log the "dancefloor list: THROW|MISMATCH" line (call #, ver, count, gc a->b, slept ms, async starts, actor/followers), the "dancefloor repro: cycle #n phase P lot L cam seen|far Dm actor X partner Y floor_sims K calls C" line before it (its cycle: the last with C < call #; the lot field of both lines names the floor), and the [CrashForensics] Light lines around it. CLEARS: PASS with dancefloordiag_throws = 0 and _mismatch = 0, calls >= 20; the script error report lists any "Collection was modified" in the game log (REPORT, never FAIL).
